name: Cloudial Picklist Path
description: A reusable Salesforce LWC chevron picklist path with describe or explicit steps, event/update/readOnly modes, Flow and record-page exposure, theming, and optional celebration.
features: Chevron path from picklist describe or explicit steps
Interaction modes: event, update, and readOnly
Nested LWC, Flow Screen, and Lightning record page exposure
Excluded values, label overrides, and disabled steps
LTR/RTL direction and CSS custom property theming
Optional celebration confetti with reduced-motion skip
whenToUse: Use when a Salesforce UI needs a reusable picklist progress path that can be nested, placed on a record page or Flow screen, and optionally write the field via Lightning Data Service.
